title: US & Russia Negotiate Again. In 1962 It Almost Caused Nuclear War #shorts
description:
The US and Russia are negotiating again. In October 1962, the last great standoff between them brought the world to the edge of nuclear war over missiles in Cuba.

Opening and closing footage: Trump, Putin meet for Alaska 2025 Summit B-Roll, DVIDS (public domain).
Archive footage: 1962-10-25 The Cuban Crisis, Universal Studios newsreel (CC0, via Wikimedia Commons).
Nikita Khrushchev 1962, unknown author (CC BY-SA 3.0 NL, via Wikimedia Commons).
John F. Kennedy, U.S. Navy photo (public domain, via Wikimedia Commons).
Paintings made for this Short. Music: Beyond the Lows (YouTube Audio Library).

#shorts #history #coldwar
comment: Was Khrushchev's decision to place missiles in Cuba a reckless gamble or a logical response to US missiles in Turkey?
